adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real architectural concern in the new parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts function. Looking at lines 14-27, the function uses APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED to decide which schema to use for validation, but this global state doesn't actually indicate the origin of the response being validated. The function is called from multiple places (GoogleCalendarService, Office365CalendarService, ZoomVideoApiAdapter, SalesforceCalendarService) after refreshOAuthTokens returns, but refreshOAuthTokens itself already branches on APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED to decide whether to call the sync endpoint or the original refresh function. This creates a design issue where the validation schema selection is disconnected from the actual response source. However, this is an architectural/design concern rather than a bug - the code will still function, just with potentially inappropriate validation in edge cases.
